mission: Audit-only (FROZEN) — composition_snapshot JSON column + write sites + zero UPDATE invariant
verdict: GREEN — schema correct, write sites identified, copy-forward path preserves immutability

schema_definition.position: after item_extras (legacy item_extras + item_variations JSON columns retained for backward-compat reads)
schema_definition.default_value: NULL (nullable column; legacy rows pre-T07 have NULL — OrderItemResource handles fallback to raw item_variations/item_extras JSON cf. L31-36)

build_then_insert_sites.context: calculateOrder — bulk insert payload row construction
build_then_insert_sites.operation: INSERT (json_encode + array element in mass-insert payload)

build_then_insert_sites.context: Legacy inline pricing path #1 — store order items (POS/web order)
build_then_insert_sites.operation: INSERT (json_encode + array element in mass-insert payload)

copy_forward_sites.context: Refund counter-entry mirror — clones parent OrderItem with negated qty/total
copy_forward_sites.operation: INSERT (Eloquent OrderItem::create with snapshot copied verbatim)
copy_forward_sites.trust_level: Copy-forward — preserves NF525 immutability (mirror order is part of the audit chain, snapshot in the mirror must match parent)
copy_forward_sites.rationale: The refund mirror order is a NEW order_items row (different order_id), so this is technically a 6th INSERT site. But it copies an already-immutable snapshot value rather than re-computing it. NF525-compliant: the original frozen snapshot is preserved on the mirror, ensuring 6-year reprint reconciles correctly.

task_contract_reconciliation.task_states_5_write_sites: Confirmed. Plan §6 Sub 6.2 T-6.2.1 says '5 write sites'. This refers to the 5 sites where CompositionSnapshotBuilder::build() produces a fresh snapshot for a new order.
task_contract_reconciliation.refund_mirror_is_6th_insert_but_copy_for: RefundWithCounterEntryService L136 is a 6th INSERT site but is a copy of a frozen value, not a fresh snapshot. It does not re-enter the audit perimeter for snapshot correctness — the source snapshot was already audited at its creation site.
task_contract_reconciliation.sentinel_test_PR03: Zone5PricingSsotConvergenceSentinelTest::test_pr03_* greps app/ for any UPDATE/save/assign on composition_snapshot and asserts ZERO offenders. This catches both refund and main paths.

findings.observation: Eloquent `'composition_snapshot' => 'array'` cast — reads JSON column into PHP array transparently. PR03-bis sentinel asserts this cast via reflection.
ALL insertion paths use `json_encode($compositionSnapshot)` or copy the already-encoded value from the parent row. Eloquent cast on read deserializes uniformly. No mixed encoded/raw write paths.

Preloads `dbAttributes` collection ONCE before the per-item loop, then passes it into snapshotBuilder->build(). Avoids N+1 inside the snapshot builder (the builder otherwise does its own attribute lookup at L55-57). Performance optimization correct.

findings.ref: database/migrations/* — no immutability trigger for order_items.composition_snapshot
findings.observation: Per CLAUDE.md §8, NF525-critical immutable columns (audit_logs hash chain, z_reports) have BEFORE DELETE / BEFORE UPDATE SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' triggers. The composition_snapshot column does NOT have an equivalent DB-level BEFORE UPDATE trigger. Wave 1 (NF525 fiscal audit) and the Zone5 sentinel docblock both acknowledge this as V1.1 backlog. Application-layer is the only enforcement today.
findings.recommendation_v1_1: Add migration: `CREATE TRIGGER order_items_composition_snapshot_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON order_items FOR EACH ROW IF OLD.composition_snapshot IS NOT NULL AND NEW.composition_snapshot <> OLD.composition_snapshot THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT = 'NF525: composition_snapshot is immutable'; END IF;`. MySQL prod only — SQLite test driver lacks SIGNAL.

findings.observation: Mid-day repricing safety: when admin updates items.price, only NEW order rows pick up the new value. EXISTING order_items rows retain their frozen `price` + `total_price` + `composition_snapshot.lines[].unit_price`. Verified end-to-end by Zone5 PR04 sentinel (creates order, mutates items.price, asserts old order_items unchanged + new order picks up new price).

Read path prefers `composition_snapshot` when non-NULL, falls back to raw `item_variations` / `item_extras` JSON columns for legacy pre-T07 rows. Backward-compat with 6-year fiscal retention preserved. No path forces a re-encode on read.
